query:
INSERT INTO kanban_history (kanban_task_id, action, initial_board, final_board, previous_values)
        SELECT
            CASE WHEN d.task_id = $1 THEN d.depends_on_id ELSE d.task_id END,
            'dependency_removed', NULL, NULL,
            jsonb_build_object(
                'depends_on_id', CAST($2 AS text),
                'title', COALESCE(NULLIF(del.title, ''), '(deleted task)')
            )
        FROM kanban_task_dependencies d
        LEFT JOIN kanban_tasks del ON del.id = $3
        WHERE d.task_id = $4 OR d.depends_on_id = $5
